title: Dining Plan Agreement: One Plan per Customer and Household Sharing
content:
## Holding of plans under the Dining Plan

**1. One plan at a time.** A customer holds at most one Dining Plan at a time; the limit is 1 plan per customer.

**2. Household sharing.** Where household sharing applies to the plan, both occupants of a double-occupancy apartment redeem from that one plan. Household sharing is provided on all six plans of the Dining Plan.

**3. Opening a new plan.** A new plan may be opened only when the customer has no other plan in pending start, active or cancel pending status. Whether such a plan exists is read from the company's plan records for that customer, before the new plan is opened; the plans looked at are the plans held by that same customer.

## Clause 3 by plan status

The condition is complete as stated ("only when"), so each status of an existing plan of the same customer resolves as follows:

| Status of the customer's other plan | Effect on opening a new plan |
|---|---|
| Pending start | A new plan may not be opened |
| Active | A new plan may not be opened |
| Cancel pending | A new plan may not be opened |
| Ended | Does not stand in the way |
| No other plan on record | Does not stand in the way |

## Illustrations (hypothetical customers)

- A customer whose earlier plan is in cancel pending status, its end date still ahead, already holds a plan in one of the three listed statuses; a new plan is not opened for that customer while it remains so.
- A customer whose only earlier plan has ended holds no plan in a listed status, so clause 3 does not prevent a new plan.
- Two spouses sharing a double-occupancy apartment, one of whom holds a plan, both redeem their meals from that single plan under clause 2.
